# National Fire Safety Institute (NFSI)

> > NFSI provides comprehensive fire safety training, industrial safety certification, and disaster management programs through HSEdx in Vadodara, Gujarat.

The National Fire Safety Institute offers diploma programs, corporate training, and skill development courses in fire safety and industrial safety. NFSI conducts practical rescue drills, certification exams, and maintains partnerships with organizations like Labour Employment & Environment Development Council for workforce development.

## Key Topics

- Fire Safety Training
- Industrial Safety
- Disaster Management
- Personal Protective Equipment (PPE)
- HSEdx Learning Platform
- Skill Development Programs
- Rescue Drills & Practical Exams
- Corporate Training
- Safety Certification & Diplomas
- Vadodara, Gujarat
- Online Safety Courses
- Fireman Training
- Workplace Safety Standards
- Emergency Response
- Social Welfare & Employment
